title: muscle_force + tendon_capacity
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0001: Structural co-design of muscle and tendon allows enhanced force transmission without rupture.
actual_result: Static force balance calculation based on assumed specific tension (30 N/cm^2) and tendon UTS (100 MPa). Produced nominal safety factors.
open_question: Does dynamic loading, tendon viscoelastic hysteresis, and muscle-tendon interaction preserve safety under +20% force?
architectural_impact: None (neutral baseline). Assumed biological scaling.

title: sprint energy and drag lower-bound
hypothesis_tested: Physical lower bound on sprint mechanical energy under aerodynamic drag.
actual_result: Aerodynamic drag equation and kinetic energy summation for 100m sprint. Minimum mechanical work calculated.
open_question: How does internal muscle efficiency vary during rapid acceleration phases?
architectural_impact: Sets physical floor for mechanical power in sprinting.

title: thermal energy budget
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0004: Whole-body thermal storage and dissipation limit sustained high-power output.
actual_result: Calculated core body temperature rise from metabolic heat without active cooling. Confirmed thermal bottleneck.
open_question: In-vivo sweating efficiency, convection boundaries, and organ thermal tolerance limits.
architectural_impact: Demands active cooling or strict thermal dissipation in all architectures.

title: oxygen delivery by Fick principle
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0004: Systemic oxygen delivery governed by cardiac output and A-V O2 difference.
actual_result: Fick equation scaling shows maximal VO2 limited by maximal cardiac output and hemoglobin concentration.
open_question: Peripheral diffusion capacity and capillary-to-fiber transit time limits at extreme flows.
architectural_impact: Constrains maximum aerobic ATP production across all architectures.

title: illustrative reaction delay budget
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0002: Neuro-muscular latency budget can be decomposed into axonal, synaptic, and electromechanical delays.
actual_result: Sum of physiological delays gives nominal 100-150 ms reaction latency.
open_question: Can spinal pre-reflex loops or sensory prediction bypass peripheral axonal conduction delays?
architectural_impact: Highlights fundamental limits of unmyelinated/myelinated biological conduction.

title: idealized vascular diffusion geometry
hypothesis_tested: Krogh cylinder model estimates capillary density needed for increased metabolic flux.
actual_result: Krogh diffusion equation solved for varying inter-capillary distances. Confirmed diffusion gradient limit.
open_question: In-vivo capillary hematocrit heterogeneity, tortuosity, and dynamic flow regulation.
architectural_impact: Architecture B (bioengineered muscle) must match or exceed native capillary density.

title: Частичная калибровка и отложенные агрегаты
hypothesis_tested: Multi-compartment ODE model can be calibrated to literature aggregate curves.
actual_result: Model tuned to match mean published exercise curves. Demonstrated mathematical feasibility but lacked individual validation.
open_question: Does parameter tuning to mean curves generalize to individual dynamic trajectories?
architectural_impact: None.

title: Связанные механика–кислород–тепло–управление
hypothesis_tested: Coupled multi-physics ODE integration simulates physiological constraints simultaneously.
actual_result: Coupled ODE solver executed across 4 subsystems without numerical divergence.
open_question: Are the coupling parameters physically identifiable from observable biological data?
architectural_impact: Identified coupled trade-offs in simulation.

title: Раздельная UQ и глобальная чувствительность
hypothesis_tested: Sobol sensitivity indices identify dominant parameter uncertainties in coupled ODEs.
actual_result: Sobol analysis revealed that active muscle volume and metabolic efficiency explain >70% of variance.
open_question: How to experimentally bound the top sensitivity parameters in living human subjects?
architectural_impact: Directs focus towards active muscle volume and energy efficiency.

title: Условный Pareto-поиск внутренних архитектур
hypothesis_tested: Multi-objective Pareto optimization can identify optimal biological vs biohybrid trade-offs.
actual_result: Generated Pareto frontiers for force, mass, power, and thermal endurance in synthetic parameter space.
open_question: Do the synthesized Pareto points violate unmodeled anatomical or biological constraints?
architectural_impact: Showed theoretical trade-off frontiers between mass, power, and cooling.

title: CPE45: исходные данные, participant holdout и отрицательная проверка
hypothesis_tested: Cycle 2 ODE model predicts held-out participant dynamic profiles during prolonged exercise.
actual_result: Falsified. Model error on held-out participants exceeded acceptable limits (NRMSE > 60%). NEG-0004.
open_question: Why did the model collapse on individual held-out dynamic data?
architectural_impact: Barred declaring Cycle 2 model validated.

title: CPE45: динамика энергии, механики, утомления и тепла 2700 s
hypothesis_tested: TARGET-CPE45 protocol (2700 s complex repeated bouts) can be simulated with bounded ODE dynamics.
actual_result: Simulated 2700s continuous profile with alternating high-intensity and recovery bouts.
open_question: Does biological fatigue accumulation follow the simulated linear/exponential kinetics over 45 min?
architectural_impact: Established TARGET-CPE45 as a formal simulation benchmark.

title: CPE45: чувствительность, UQ, сходимость и контрпримеры
hypothesis_tested: CPE45 simulation is structurally stable under wide parameter variations.
actual_result: Found severe sensitivity to recovery rate and thermal accumulation parameters. Multiple counterexamples generated.
open_question: How to constrain the unidentifiable recovery parameters with experimental data?
architectural_impact: Proved that unconstrained simulation cannot prove biological feasibility.

title: CPE45: условное сравнение архитектур I/II/III в трёх средах
hypothesis_tested: Comparative performance of hypothetical enhancement architectures under thermal stress.
actual_result: Simulated architectures I (native bio), II (bioengineered muscle), III (biohybrid) in cold, temperate, and hot environments.
open_question: Are the biological assumptions regarding augmented vascularization realistic?
architectural_impact: Highlighted thermal failure of high-power biohybrid architectures in hot environments.

title: CPE45: причинно-диагностический аудит прежнего провала
hypothesis_tested: Mathematical diagnosis of parameter collinearity causing EXP-0011 holdout failure.
actual_result: Demonstrated that simultaneous estimation of baseline VO2, gain, and time constant from unforced ramp leads to singular Fisher Information Matrix.
open_question: What minimal protocol perturbation breaks the collinearity?
architectural_impact: Mandated pre-test parameter locking and rigorous identifiability checks.

title: Независимая новая когорта: preregistered grouped power validation
hypothesis_tested: Preregistered recovery model predicts multi-subject grouped power performance.
actual_result: Falsified. Grouped power model failed cross-subject generalization test. NEG-0016.
open_question: Is whole-body external power an unobservable mixture of heterogeneous muscle groups?
architectural_impact: Proved that external mechanical power cannot identify internal recovery states.

title: Структурная и практическая неидентифицируемость восстановления
hypothesis_tested: Rigorous proof of structural vs practical unidentifiability of recovery kinetics from work output.
actual_result: Rank of Jacobian and Lie derivatives proves non-invertible state map. Infinite parameter families yield identical external work.
open_question: Can direct in-vivo spectroscopic sensing (31P-MRS, NIRS) resolve the unidentifiability?
architectural_impact: Redirected research from macroscopic power to local tissue spectroscopy.

title: Физически ограниченная альтернативная структура и 2700s stability
hypothesis_tested: Bounded non-negative ODE formulation prevents unphysical runaway states during 2700s simulations.
actual_result: Formulated projection operator ODEs preserving [0, 1] saturation bounds and mass/energy conservation.
open_question: Does mathematical boundedness guarantee biological realism?
architectural_impact: Enforced non-negative state constraints on all subsequent models.

title: Независимый вывод симметрий и аудит каналов наблюдения D2
hypothesis_tested: Continuous Lie symmetry analysis identifies unobservable state manifolds in 13D model.
actual_result: Derived 4 continuous scaling symmetries. Proved that only 9 invariant coordinates are observable.
open_question: What physical observables break the 4 continuous symmetries?
architectural_impact: Reduced model dimension from 13D to 9D canonical quotient manifold.

title: Полученные PCr данные и воспроизводимый аудит публичного доступа
hypothesis_tested: Audit of public availability, formats, and licensing of human 31P-MRS datasets.
actual_result: Cataloged published 31P-MRS studies; found that >90% publish only summary statistics, not raw time series.
open_question: Where can fully open, individual breath-by-breath and raw MRS series be legally obtained?
architectural_impact: Highlighted the critical bottleneck of open raw biomedical data.

title: Условный D/E/profile optimal experimental design
hypothesis_tested: Optimal protocol design maximizes determinant of Fisher Information Matrix for model parameters.
actual_result: Designed multi-step exercise protocol (bouts of 30s, 60s, 120s at varying intensities) maximizing parameter identifiability.
open_question: Will human subjects adhere to complex non-standard step protocols without premature exhaustion?
architectural_impact: Defined experimental protocol requirements for future human validation.

title: Девятипараметрическая редукция и synthetic robustness audit
hypothesis_tested: Exact quotient reduction from 13D to 9D preserves dynamical invariants under synthetic noise.
actual_result: Simulated 9D reduced model with Monte Carlo noise; verified that quotient system retains exact dynamical trajectory.
open_question: Does the 9D reduction obscure clinically relevant absolute concentrations?
architectural_impact: Established the 9D system as the mathematically minimal identifiable representation.

title: Public CPET acquisition and metabolic-anchor metrology
hypothesis_tested: Metrological evaluation of breath-by-breath spirometry physics and calibration standards.
actual_result: Audited volume turbine, paramagnetic O2, and NDIR CO2 sensors. Defined calibration error propagation bounds.
open_question: What is the true breath-by-breath noise variance across different ventilation volumes?
architectural_impact: Set measurement noise thresholds for systemic validation.

title: Conditional systemic identification and measurement-map symmetry
hypothesis_tested: Spiroergometry measurement map connects systemic VO2 to whole-body metabolic power.
actual_result: Identified systemic parameters from open CPET; demonstrated that pulmonary delay tau is critical.
open_question: Can systemic identification predict local muscle bioenergetics?
architectural_impact: None.

title: Preregistered independent systemic-cost validation
hypothesis_tested: Preregistered ODE model predicts systemic oxygen consumption across independent exercise profiles.
actual_result: Model achieved acceptable systemic fit on independent CPET ramp profiles (R2 > 0.85 on whole-body VO2).
open_question: Does success on systemic VO2 imply validity of underlying local muscle state variables?
architectural_impact: Validated systemic metabolic cost module only.

title: Real-data calibration falsification and unchanged 9D energy bridge
hypothesis_tested: Systemic CPET calibration identifies local muscle phosphagen and glycogen reserves.
actual_result: Falsified. Proved that infinite combinations of local active muscle volume and local ATP turnover produce identical systemic VO2. NEG-0018.
open_question: How to directly measure active muscle volume and local metabolic fluxes in vivo?
architectural_impact: Formally separated systemic metabolic modeling from local muscle bioenergetics.

title: PCr Recovery Kinetics, Acidosis Coupling and Asymptote Sensitivity
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0006: Non-linear PCr recovery kinetics coupled to intracellular pH explain post-exercise recovery asymptotes.
actual_result: Originally claimed empirical discovery; retracted to confirmed computational scenario after audit showed parameters were fit without cross-validation. NEG-0020.
open_question: Can pH-dependent PCr kinetics be independently validated on un-fit human 31P-MRS series?
architectural_impact: Retracted empirical claim; preserved computational hypothesis.

title: Pulmonary Oxygen Kinetics, Transport Delay and Inseparability
hypothesis_tested: Deconvolution of circulatory transport delay (15-30s) allows reconstruction of muscle O2 consumption from mouth VO2.
actual_result: Proved that deconvolution is ill-conditioned under breath-by-breath noise; muscle O2 uptake is practically inseparable from mouth VO2 without invasive sensors. NEG-0021.
open_question: Can near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) provide local capillary deoxygenation kinetics to constrain deconvolution?
architectural_impact: Enforced requirement of explicit transport delay parameter tau in all systemic models.

title: Local-Systemic Coupling and Excess CO2 Bicarbonate Buffering
hypothesis_tested: RER > 1.0 during heavy exercise reflects bicarbonate buffering of lactic acid, not substrate oxidation.
actual_result: Derived carbon dioxide balance equation showing excess VCO2 = d[HCO3-]/dt. Confirmed that caloric equivalent cannot be computed from RER > 1.0. NEG-0022.
open_question: What is the true rate of substrate oxidation above the respiratory compensation point?
architectural_impact: Prohibited calculating metabolic heat or fat/carb oxidation from unclipped RER > 1.0.

title: Absolute Metabolic Energy Scale and Active Volume Uncertainty
hypothesis_tested: Active muscle volume (V_active) scaling introduces massive uncertainty in local energy turnover.
actual_result: Demonstrated that varying V_active between 15% and 60% of total quadriceps volume varies estimated local ATP turnover by 400% for the same external power output. NEG-0023.
open_question: Can dynamic motor unit recruitment models constrain V_active in real time?
architectural_impact: Identified V_active as the primary scientific blocker for local muscle energy models.

title: Mechanical Power Prediction and Observational Bridge Boundary
hypothesis_tested: Direct conversion of single-muscle sarcomere mechanics to whole-body cycle ergometer power.
actual_result: Retracted invalid comparison. Proved that joint biomechanics, antagonist co-activation, and pedal kinematics break 1-to-1 force-to-power mapping. NEG-0024.
open_question: What intermediate biomechanical linkages are required to bridge sarcomere force to joint torque?
architectural_impact: Mandated an explicit biomechanical joint layer between muscle force and external power.

title: Anatomical MRI Muscle Volumetry vs Dynamic Functional Recruitment
hypothesis_tested: Anatomical muscle volume from MRI equals functionally active muscle volume during contractions.
actual_result: Literature meta-analysis confirmed that active volume is dynamic and submaximal: 20-75% depending on torque and cadence. Anatomical volume is only an upper bound. NEG-0025.
open_question: How to predict functional recruitment fraction without in-bore MRI during exercise?
architectural_impact: Prohibited equating anatomical muscle volume to V_active in ODE models.

title: Absolute Phosphagen Quantification and Thermodynamic Scale: Literature Grounding
hypothesis_tested: Resting human muscle [PCr] and [ATP] are constrained within tight physiological intervals.
actual_result: Systematic literature grounding established human resting concentrations: [PCr] = 28-34 mmol/kg wet wt, [ATP] = 5.5-7.0 mmol/kg wet wt, [Pi] = 3-5 mmol/kg wet wt, pH = 7.04-7.08. DEC-0014.
open_question: What are the absolute limits of phosphagen depletion before catastrophic rigor/failure?
architectural_impact: Locked resting phosphagen initial conditions in all bioenergetic models.

title: Local Oxygen Baseline (M_loc) Bounding: Invasive A-V vs ASL and Near-Infrared Spectrometry
hypothesis_tested: Local muscle resting oxygen consumption can be accurately bounded from literature measurements.
actual_result: Established human resting muscle VO2 baseline: 0.15 - 0.35 mL O2 / min / 100g tissue. Bounded resting local perfusion. DEC-0014.
open_question: How rapidly does local capillary perfusion scale at contraction onset?
architectural_impact: Constrained baseline resting metabolic rates in tissue ODEs.

title: Measurement Map Identifiability vs Ideal Channels
hypothesis_tested: Real-world spectroscopic sensors (31P-MRS coil sensitivity, NIRS pathlength factor) preserve parameter identifiability.
actual_result: Proven that uncalibrated spectroscopic gain and baseline offsets introduce structural unidentifiability. Without absolute standards, rate constants cannot be uniquely solved. NEG-0026.
open_question: Can multi-echo or phantom-referenced calibration restore rank identifiability?
architectural_impact: Mandated physical measurement mapping layer in all sensor integration.

title: Macro-Model Transferability Audit: D2 9D Quotient vs Local Physiology
hypothesis_tested: The 9D reduced quotient model directly describes local intramuscular bioenergetics.
actual_result: Proven that the 9D macro-model represents a lump-sum whole-body system and cannot be transferred to local muscle tissue without spatial discretization and local recruitment modeling. NEG-0027.
open_question: What is the formal mapping between multi-muscle distributed ODEs and systemic 9D dynamics?
architectural_impact: Barred using systemic 9D models as surrogates for local muscle fatigue.

title: Empirical Acquisition Audit of Lower-Limb HD-sEMG and Dynamometry
hypothesis_tested: Public repositories contain fully open, synchronous HD-sEMG and force dynamometry datasets for lower limb.
actual_result: Systematic audit of 12 repositories revealed that 10 were gated/restricted or lacked synchronous joint angle and force channels. Identified open candidates. ISS-0019.
open_question: How to obtain fully open, unrestricted raw dynamic motor unit data?
architectural_impact: Guided selection of Bird 2026 and PhysioNet datasets.

title: Biophysical Forward Simulation Model of Motor Unit Recruitment
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0008: Forward biophysical simulation (Henneman size principle + volume conductor) can model surface EMG from motor unit action potentials.
actual_result: Built forward simulation of 120 motor units. Proved that surface EMG amplitude is non-linearly related to active muscle volume and saturates due to amplitude cancellation. Confirmed HYP-0008.
open_question: Can high-density EMG decomposition invert the forward model to yield true motor unit counts in vivo?
architectural_impact: Verified that single-channel sEMG cannot identify V_active (HYP-0008).

title: Real-Data Identifiability and Profile Likelihood of Local Energy Models
hypothesis_tested: Profile likelihood analysis detects parameter boundaries and non-identifiable valleys in local PCr recovery ODEs.
actual_result: Profile likelihood on synthetic and literature time points showed completely flat likelihood valleys for Vmax and V_active without absolute calibration. NEG-0028.
open_question: What is the minimal set of spectroscopic priors required to make the profile likelihood quadratic?
architectural_impact: Established profile likelihood as mandatory identifiability test before fitting.

title: Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) Cross-Validation Algorithm Demonstration
hypothesis_tested: LOSO cross-validation algorithm reliably detects overfitting and data leakage across subjects.
actual_result: Demonstrated synthetic LOSO pipeline; proved that random split yields falsely high R2 while LOSO detects true generalizability.
open_question: Application of LOSO to real multi-subject biological datasets.
architectural_impact: Enforced LOSO cross-validation policy for all subsequent empirical cycles.

title: SUBJECT-01 Integration: Functional Power, Recovery Limits, and Whole-Body Feasibility
hypothesis_tested: Integrated budget accounting checks consistency across force (+20%), adaptation (+25%), and CPE45 (2700s).
actual_result: Accounting audit revealed severe metabolic and thermal incompatibilities: +20% sustained force increases heat dissipation requirement beyond normal cutaneous evaporative capacity by 35%. NEG-0029.
open_question: Can subcutaneous or vascular heat exchangers dissipate the excess 35% heat load?
architectural_impact: Directly challenged the physical feasibility of uncooled enhancement architectures.

title: Rehman 2024 31P-MRS Real Data: Protocol Timing Reconstruction and Single-Subject PCr Fit
hypothesis_tested: HYP-0007: Single-subject in-vivo 31P-MRS PCr recovery time course can be fit by non-linear oxidative phosphorylation ODE.
actual_result: First real in-vivo spectroscopic dataset evaluated (N=1, plantarflexion, Rehman 2024, Zenodo). ODE model fit individual PCr recovery with R2 = 0.941 and RMSE = 4.2% PCr. Protocol timing reconstructed. DEC-0016.
open_question: N=1 single subject cannot prove cross-subject generalizability; does the parameter set generalize to other subjects and muscles?
architectural_impact: Scientifically frozen as N=1 proof-of-concept; prohibited generalizing to general population without multi-subject cohorts.

title: PhysioNet ACTES Cycloergometer Multi-Subject Graded CPET: Systemic Factorial Validation
hypothesis_tested: Dynamic ODE model with transport delay and body mass outperforms static linear models in predicting breath-by-breath VO2 during cycle ergometry across independent human subjects.
actual_result: Evaluated on N=18 independent subjects (PhysioNet ACTES). Factorial hierarchy: M4 (dynamic ODE + mass, R2=0.74, RMSE=0.29 L/min) significantly outperformed M1 (static linear, R2=0.52, RMSE=0.39 L/min, p=1.0e-8). Corrigendum: apparent efficiency is 37.49% (not 25.5%); delta efficiency unidentifiable without steady-state steps. DEC-0017, DEC-0019.
open_question: Does systemic cycle ergometer VO2 kinetics transfer to running locomotion or local muscle fatigue?
architectural_impact: Validated whole-body systemic oxygen kinetics model for cycling; proved that true muscle delta-efficiency is not identifiable from unlagged ramp.

title: PhysioNet Malaga Treadmill CPET: Subject-Level Grouped Locomotion Validation
hypothesis_tested: Factorial dynamic models generalize to running locomotion across a large independent cohort under strict subject-level GroupKFold (zero leakage).
actual_result: Evaluated on N=846 independent human subjects (981 incremental treadmill tests, 575,087 observations, PhysioNet Malaga). Under strict GroupKFold, M4 (dynamic ODE + mass, R2=0.6648, RMSE=404 mL/min) significantly outperformed M1 (R2=0.3296, RMSE=570 mL/min, p=6.8e-26). Cross-modal transfer formula from cycling failed completely (NEG-0037). DEC-0019.
open_question: How to physically model the mechanical work of running without direct force plate measurements?
architectural_impact: Validated large-cohort systemic VO2 dynamics for treadmill running; proved complete failure of ad-hoc cycling-to-running cross-modal transfer.

title: Human In Vivo Vastus Lateralis Force, Activation Decoupling, and UWB Radar Generalization
hypothesis_tested: In-vivo knee extension torque can be predicted across unseen human subjects using raw UWB radar features or single engineered Hill composite features without individual calibration.
actual_result: Evaluated on Bird et al. 2026 raw dynamic arrays (DATA_Dynamic_Knee.mat, 3,226 observations, N=6 dynamic, N=46 cohort). Findings: (1) Surface EMG M1 baseline achieves cross-subject LOSO R2=0.4628 in combined passive/active conditions; (2) Uncalibrated UWB Ridge regression collapses in LOSO cross-validation to R2 = -2.4457 +/- 2.2077 (NRMSE=47.25%), failing on 5 of 6 held-out humans (NEG-0039); (3) Engineered Hill feature M4 (R2=0.3251) shows NO verified advantage over M1 (Delta R2 = -0.1377, 95% CI [-0.2814, +0.0061], p=0.0571) (NEG-0039); (4) Single-joint torque cannot be extrapolated to whole-body strength or TARGET-CPE45 (NEG-0038). DEC-0020.
open_question: Can subject-specific non-linear calibration or high-density EMG restore multi-muscle torque prediction?
architectural_impact: Prohibited claiming cross-subject generalizability for uncalibrated UWB radar; barred claiming superiority for single engineered feature M4; preserved full multi-scale ODE architecture unfalsified; barred extrapolating single-joint torque to whole-body enhancement.
